name: [Template] Magical Foundation
description: Define who can use this magic, how it is acquired, what practitioners can sense, and what is impossible without a specific ability.
appearance: Describe the shared sensory signature of the system: light, sound, temperature, symbols, bodily changes, or environmental reactions.
activation: Always active while the character retains access to the magic system.
effect: Establishes the practitioner's baseline magical permissions. Replace this text with the actions every user of the system may attempt without learning a separate ability.
outcomeGuidance: Use this definition to establish boundaries, not to grant unlimited solutions. Specific techniques should still require their own canonical entries.
limitations: Define at least one thing this magic can never accomplish.
Define what disrupts or suppresses access to the system.
Do not let this foundation replace specific learned abilities.
counters: Replace with the system-wide suppression method.
prerequisites: Replace with the source of magical access: birth, pact, training, exposure, implant, faith, or another cause.

masteryLadder.name: Awakened
masteryLadder.requirements: Gain access to the magic system.
masteryLadder.benefits: Perceive and perform its baseline magical actions.

masteryLadder.name: Attuned
masteryLadder.benefits: Recognize familiar manifestations and reduce minor accidental side effects.

masteryLadder.name: Transcendent
masteryLadder.benefits: Replace with the highest permission the setting allows without breaking its core limits.

gmNotes: Edit this entry first. It is the constitution of the magic system. Keep its permissions narrow and put individual effects in separate abilities.

name: [Template] Basic Invocation
description: The system's most common deliberate magical technique. Replace this with a concrete effect that demonstrates the system's identity.
appearance: Describe what an observer sees and what the caster physically does.
activation: One deliberate action requiring a visible gesture, spoken phrase, focused thought, or other defined trigger.

costs.condition: Paid whether the effect succeeds or fails after release.

range: Replace: self, touch, near, sight, or exact distance
effect: Replace with one clear mechanical or narrative outcome. State what changes in the fiction and avoid vague language such as 'controls energy.'
outcomeGuidance: On partial success, preserve the intended direction but add a proportionate cost, reduced effect, exposed position, or unstable aftermath.
limitations: Requires an unobstructed method of targeting.
Cannot produce effects outside the defined magical domain.
counters: A reaction carrying the template-magic counter relationship can interrupt it.

masteryLadder.name: Novice
masteryLadder.benefits: Produce the base effect under ordinary conditions.

masteryLadder.name: Adept
masteryLadder.benefits: Replace with one bounded improvement to reliability, range, or control.

masteryLadder.name: Master
masteryLadder.requirements: Use the invocation to resolve a major campaign obstacle.
masteryLadder.benefits: Replace with the strongest setting-appropriate expression of this technique.

upgradeNodes.name: Precision
upgradeNodes.description: Replace with a safer or more selective version of the effect.

upgradeNodes.name: Overcharge
upgradeNodes.description: Replace with a stronger version that also carries an explicit additional cost or risk.

upgradeNodes.name: Signature Expression
upgradeNodes.description: Create a character-specific expression without changing the canonical limits of the ability.

gmNotes: Duplicate this entry for the system's common spells or techniques. Keep each duplicate focused on one durable capability.

name: [Template] Sustained Ward
description: A maintained protective effect that demonstrates duration, upkeep, and disruption rules.
appearance: Describe the boundary of the ward and how strain becomes visible as it weakens.
activation: One action to establish; concentration, posture, chant, device control, or another sustained behavior to maintain.

costs.condition: Additional cost may be required each scene or after absorbing a major effect.

targets: One creature, object, or bounded position
area: Replace if the ward protects an area
effect: Replace with the exact threats the ward resists, redirects, reveals, or delays. State what it does not stop.
outcomeGuidance: A ward should create protection without erasing consequences. Powerful impacts may drain resources, break the ward, displace the target, or expose a weakness.
limitations: Ends when maintenance is interrupted.
Does not protect against threats outside its defined domain.
Only one copy may be maintained by the same practitioner unless an upgrade says otherwise.
counters: An ability carrying the template-ward counter relationship.

masteryLadder.name: Adept
masteryLadder.requirements: Maintain the ward through a serious disruption.
masteryLadder.benefits: Replace with improved duration, resilience, or coverage.

upgradeNodes.name: Shared Boundary
upgradeNodes.description: Replace with a method for protecting an additional target or small area.

gmNotes: Use active effects and runtime state to track this ward during play.

name: [Template] Counter Technique
description: A reactive technique that interrupts, redirects, grounds, or destabilizes magic from this system.
appearance: Describe the brief tell that marks a successful counter and how a failed attempt looks different.
activation: Reaction when the practitioner perceives an eligible magical effect being formed or released.

costs.condition: Spent when the counter is attempted.

range: Replace with the maximum countering distance
effect: Replace with whether the counter cancels, weakens, redirects, delays, or exposes the incoming effect. Define how relative mastery changes the outcome.
outcomeGuidance: Against a stronger effect, prefer reduction or redirection over automatic cancellation unless the setting explicitly supports absolute counters.
limitations: The incoming effect must be perceived in time.
Cannot counter domains this practitioner does not understand unless an upgrade permits it.
counters: Hidden casting, overwhelming force, unfamiliar magical structure, or attacks outside the reaction window.

masteryLadder.name: Adept
masteryLadder.benefits: Attempt to cancel familiar magic or weaken unfamiliar magic.

upgradeNodes.name: Reflection
upgradeNodes.description: Replace with tightly bounded conditions for redirecting rather than cancelling an effect.

gmNotes: The counterTags connect this ability to the sample invocation and ward. Rename the shared tags consistently across your finished system.

name: [Template] Transformation
description: A state-changing ability with explicit entry, benefits, vulnerabilities, and exit conditions.
appearance: Describe the transformation in concrete stages and identify features an observer could recognize.
activation: One action under a defined emotional, environmental, ritual, or resource condition.

costs.condition: Cannot be recovered while the form remains active.

duration: Until dismissed, disrupted, exhausted, or the scene ends
effect: Replace with the form's precise capabilities and physical changes. Identify what normal actions become harder or impossible.
outcomeGuidance: The form changes available options; it should not simply improve every action. Its advantages and liabilities should both matter in the fiction.
limitations: Cannot use abilities incompatible with the transformed body or state.
Ends under the defined disruption condition.
Leaves a visible or lasting consequence after use.
counters: Replace with a material, frequency, oath, condition, or technique that destabilizes the form.
prerequisites: Replace with a mastery tier, pact, lineage, or milestone.

masteryLadder.name: Unstable
masteryLadder.benefits: Enter the base form with all listed liabilities.

masteryLadder.name: Controlled
masteryLadder.requirements: Retain control through a major provocation or hazard.
masteryLadder.benefits: Replace with one reduced liability or improved exit condition.

upgradeNodes.name: Adaptive Form
upgradeNodes.description: Choose one bounded adaptation when transforming.

gmNotes: Use the runtime controls to mark this transformation active and to record its remaining duration or effects.

name: [Template] Forbidden Ritual
description: A rare working whose existence and rules must be confirmed against campaign lore before the Narrative Engine injects it.
appearance: Describe the site, materials, participants, and unmistakable signs produced as the ritual progresses.
activation: Extended preparation at an eligible place, followed by an uninterrupted rite.

costs.resource: Replace: rare material, sacrifice, debt, time, or magical resource
costs.condition: The cost is not fully recoverable if the completed rite is interrupted.

duration: Replace with preparation time and effect duration
effect: Replace with a consequential effect that cannot be achieved by ordinary quick techniques.
outcomeGuidance: Ritual failure should follow established preparation, opposition, or lore contradictions. Do not invent arbitrary backlash solely for drama.
limitations: Requires confirmed lore, appropriate materials, sufficient time, and a valid site.
Cannot be improvised as a normal combat action.
Consequences must remain within the campaign's established metaphysics.
counters: Disrupt a required component, participant, site condition, or sequence before completion.
prerequisites: Replace with the required mastery, text, teacher, place, or celestial condition.
loreCheckNotes: Replace this note with the exact lore claims the engine should verify, then run Lore Check and save the definition.
gmNotes: This entry is intentionally blocked from prompt injection until its Lore Check is verified.

name: [Template] Focus-Bound Power
description: A power granted by carrying or equipping a specific relic, focus, weapon, implant, grimoire, mask, or other inventory item.
appearance: Describe the item and the sign that appears when its power becomes active.
activation: Use, wield, wear, invoke, or otherwise activate the linked inventory item.

costs.resource: Replace: item charge, durability, heat, favor, or magical resource
costs.condition: Replace with how the item tracks or recovers this cost.

range: Replace with the item's reach or influence
effect: Replace with the exact power the linked item grants.
outcomeGuidance: If the item is absent, not carried, depleted, broken, or unequipped when required, the character does not have access to this ability.
limitations: Inactive unless linked to a carried inventory item.
Inactive unless the linked item is equipped.
Does not create permanent character ownership.
counters: Disarm, suppress, disable, deplete, or separate the user from the granting item through established fiction.
prerequisites: Possess and equip the linked inventory item.
gmNotes: After import, select this definition and choose its Granting Inventory Item. It remains inactive until linked.

name: [Template] Enemy Signature Action
description: A canonical supernatural action shared by one enemy type or used as a named signature move.
appearance: Describe the observable warning, release, and aftermath so players can learn to recognize it.
activation: Enemy action under a clear tactical or fictional condition.

costs.resource: Replace: cooldown, charge, position, exposed state, or no resource
costs.condition: Replace with when the enemy may use it again.

range: Replace with exact or narrative range
effect: Replace with the enemy action's exact fictional and mechanical consequences.
outcomeGuidance: Telegraph dangerous effects in proportion to their severity. Resolve consequences from established positioning and defenses.
limitations: Requires the listed trigger or setup.
Cannot ignore canonical counters or established battlefield state.
counters: Replace with at least one readable player response.
prerequisites: Enemy possesses the relevant nature, training, equipment, or magical source.
gmNotes: After import, open the Enemy Compendium and link an optional enemy action to this canonical ability.
